columns.comment: First day of the month of the month-end snapshot.
columns.name: month

columns.comment: Last calendar day of the month.
columns.name: month_end_date

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year as its starting calendar year (FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027).
columns.name: fiscal_year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label, e.g. FY2026 (Apr 2026 - Mar 2027).
columns.name: fiscal_year_label

columns.comment: Fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: fiscal_quarter_label

columns.comment: Fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1 (Apr-Sep 2026).
columns.name: fiscal_half_label

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Credit obligor records of the client summed into the row (2 when entity resolution merged two obligors).
columns.name: n_obligors

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 (1 best, 10 default) at the month-end; worst obligor when several.
columns.name: internal_grade

columns.comment: External-scale equivalent of internal_grade (AAA ... B).
columns.name: rating_equivalent

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage 1, 2 or 3 at the month-end (worst obligor).
columns.name: ifrs9_stage

columns.comment: Maximum days past due across the client's facilities at the month-end.
columns.name: days_past_due_max

columns.comment: Days-past-due bucket at the month-end: Current, 1-29, 30-59, 60-89 or 90+.
columns.name: dpd_bucket

columns.comment: Drawn credit balance at the month-end in USD. Point-in-time.
columns.name: drawn_usd

columns.comment: Committed credit limits at the month-end in USD. Point-in-time.
columns.name: limit_usd

columns.comment: drawn_usd / limit_usd at the month-end (fraction, 0.85 = 85%).
columns.name: utilisation_pct

columns.comment: Exposure at default at the month-end in USD (drawn + credit-conversion factor x undrawn). Point-in-time.
columns.name: ead_usd

columns.comment: Risk-weighted assets at the month-end in USD. Point-in-time - average across months, never sum.
columns.name: rwa_usd

columns.comment: rwa_usd / ead_usd (average risk weight, fraction).
columns.name: rwa_density

columns.comment: 12-month probability of default (fraction), EAD-weighted across obligors.
columns.name: pd_12m

columns.comment: Lifetime probability of default (fraction), EAD-weighted.
columns.name: pd_lifetime

columns.comment: Loss given default (fraction), EAD-weighted.
columns.name: lgd

columns.comment: Remaining tenor of the exposure in years, EAD-weighted.
columns.name: remaining_tenor_years

columns.comment: 12-month expected credit loss allowance at the month-end in USD. Point-in-time.
columns.name: ecl_12m_usd

columns.comment: Lifetime expected credit loss at the month-end in USD. Point-in-time.
columns.name: ecl_lifetime_usd

columns.comment: IFRS 9 ECL allowance booked at the month-end in USD (12-month for Stage 1, lifetime for Stages 2-3). Point-in-time.
columns.name: ecl_usd

columns.comment: Change in the ECL allowance versus the previous month in USD (positive = provision build, the impairment charge). Additive.
columns.name: ecl_change_usd

columns.comment: Expected loss for the month in USD (PD x LGD x EAD / 12) - the credit cost in client profitability. Additive.
columns.name: expected_loss_usd

columns.comment: Economic (unexpected-loss) capital at the month-end in USD - the RAROC denominator. Point-in-time.
columns.name: economic_capital_usd

columns.comment: Book equity allocated at 9% of EAD in USD at the month-end. Point-in-time.
columns.name: book_equity_usd

columns.comment: Capital allocated at the 12.5% target CET1 ratio of RWA in USD at the month-end - the ROE denominator. Point-in-time.
columns.name: allocated_capital_usd

columns.comment: Monthly cost of the allocated capital at the 10% cost of equity in USD. Additive.
columns.name: cost_of_capital_usd

columns.comment: True when the ECL is individually assessed (Stage 3 specific provision, e.g. Sunda from Jun-2026).
columns.name: is_individually_assessed

comment: Capital consumed by each golden client with credit exposure, per month-end (Apr-2024 to Sep-2026, Client Profitability): drawn, limit, EAD, risk-weighted assets, PD / LGD, IFRS 9 stage and ECL, expected loss, economic capital (RAROC denominator), capital allocated at the 12.5% target CET1 ratio of RWA, book equity (9% of EAD) and the monthly cost of that capital at the 10% cost of equity. Balances (drawn, EAD, RWA, ECL, capital) are month-end snapshots: never sum them across months - take the latest month or average. Expected loss, ECL change and cost of capital are monthly flows (additive). Grain: one row per golden client x month.
